protocol.title: NF-kappaB Signaling, Dynamic Range and Stochastic Switching under TNF-alpha and LPS Stimulation
protocol.platform: Fully automated microfluidic cell culture system (Gomez-Sjoberg et al., Anal. Chem. 2007)
protocol.cell_line: NIH-3T3 stably expressing p65-GFP (NF-kappaB nuclear localisation reporter)
protocol.objective: Simultaneous measurement of NF-kappaB nuclear localisation dynamics in >3000 mammalian cells under 8 doses of TNF-alpha and LPS spanning 4 orders of magnitude; characterisation of oscillation continuity, dose-response dynamic range, stochastic switching, and analog vs. digital signaling modes

key_findings.A_oscillations: Single-cell NF-kappaB oscillations under TNF-alpha are continuous over 12 h (not damped); confirmed by extended time-lapse measurements
key_findings.B_dynamic_range: Response threshold, dose-dependent activation fraction, and response time (hundreds of min near threshold; <30 min at saturating doses) characterised across 4 orders of magnitude for both ligands
key_findings.C_stochastic_switching: High-dose responses are stereotyped; intermediate and low-dose responses show cell-to-cell variability and stochastic switching arising from small fluctuations in key protein levels (modelled by modified Kearns/Hoffman NF-kappaB ODE with stochastic noise)
key_findings.D_analog_vs_digital: TNF-alpha: analog signaling (graded nuclear localisation intensity proportional to dose). LPS: digital signaling (full nuclear localisation even at lowest doses; all-or-nothing switch). Distinction reflects cell-cell communication (TNF) vs. bacterial infection (LPS) biology.

imaging.nuclear_marker: Co-stain for automated cell segmentation and tracking
imaging.cell_count: >3000 NIH-3T3 cells measured simultaneously per experiment
imaging.software: Custom cell tracking and nuclear localisation intensity extraction software

dose_tiers_encoded_in_bs.mid: intermediate (1:10 serial dilution; 9 PBS units chained)

reagents.nuclear_stain: Nuclear marker dye for cell segmentation

mathematical_model.base: Standard NF-kappaB ODE model (Kearns and Hoffman, J. Biol. Chem. 2009, 284:5439-5443)
modifications: Modified to reproduce dose-dependent reduction in response time
Stochastic noise terms added to key protein levels (IkBa, IKK) to explain switching at near-threshold doses
Used to distinguish analog (TNF-alpha) vs. digital (LPS) upstream signaling architectures

steps.name: Device priming
steps.notes: 2% Pluronics F-127 in PBS; reduces non-specific cell adhesion to microfluidic channel walls before cell seeding

steps.name: Cell seeding and adhesion
steps.notes: Cells seeded into microfluidic culture chambers in complete media; 2 h adhesion at 37 C before staining and stimulation

steps.name: Nuclear marker staining
steps.notes: Nuclear marker co-stain enables automated single-cell segmentation and tracking; 30 min incubation at 37 C. p65-GFP nuclear/cytoplasmic ratio extracted per cell at each 6-min frame.

expected_response.signaling_mode: analog (graded nuclear localisation proportional to dose)

steps.name: TNF-alpha stimulation -- intermediate dose (Dose 2, 1:10 dilution)
steps.operation: serial dilution then cell prep then mix then heat then detect

expected_response.response_character: heterogeneous; stochastic switching; some cells oscillate, some remain silent

steps.name: TNF-alpha stimulation -- near-threshold dose (Dose 3, 1:100 dilution)
steps.operation: two-step serial dilution then cell prep then mix then heat then detect

expected_response.response_character: rare stochastic switching; irregular on/off; majority of cells silent
expected_response.model_explanation: Modified NF-kappaB ODE with stochastic IkBa/IKK fluctuations reproduces observed switching statistics

steps.name: LPS stimulation -- near-saturating dose (Dose 1, 1:1 dilution)
steps.operation: mix then cell prep then mix then heat then detect

expected_response.response_character: digital ON; full nuclear p65-GFP translocation regardless of dose intensity
expected_response.signaling_mode: digital (all-or-nothing; full localisation in responding cells)
expected_response.biological_context: LPS detected via TLR4/MyD88 producing switch-like IKK activation; reflects pathogen detection vs. cell-cell communication

steps.name: LPS stimulation -- intermediate dose (Dose 2, 1:10 dilution)
steps.operation: serial dilution then cell prep then mix then heat then detect

expected_response.activation_fraction: lower than high dose but still digital
expected_response.response_character: digital ON in responding fraction; full nuclear localisation (not graded)
expected_response.key_contrast: At equivalent 1:10 dose, TNF-alpha gives graded partial localisation; LPS gives full localisation in a smaller responding fraction

steps.name: LPS stimulation -- near-threshold dose (Dose 3, 1:100 dilution)
steps.operation: two-step serial dilution then cell prep then mix then heat then detect

expected_response.response_character: digital ON in rare responding cells; full nuclear localisation even at lowest dose -- key finding
expected_response.key_finding: Even at near-threshold LPS doses, responding cells show complete nuclear localisation (digital). Equivalent TNF-alpha doses give only weak graded responses. This is the core analog-vs-digital distinction.

bioscript_compiler_notes.serial_dilution_approach: BioScript does not support numeric looping. 1:10 dilutions encoded as chained dispense of 9 PBS units (p1-p9, q1-q9, etc.) merged sequentially. 1:100 achieved by two successive 1:10 serial steps.
bioscript_compiler_notes.ascii_constraint: ANTLR4 FileStream requires pure ASCII. All Greek letters replaced: alpha -> alpha, kappa -> kappa, em-dash -> --
